definition: Amazon AppStream 2.0 streams remotely hosted desktop applications to users without requiring a local installation of each application.
entry_text: Amazon AppStream 2.0 streams remotely hosted desktop applications to users without requiring a local installation of each application.
example: A university lets students use a licensed design tool through streamed sessions.
label: Amazon AppStream 2.0

sources.note: AWS explicitly identifies Amazon WorkSpaces Applications as the renamed AppStream 2.0 and confirms remote application or desktop streaming to browsers or its client. Function matches; mark AppStream 2.0 as the former name.
